Package bcu.cmp5332.bookingsystem.utils

Class AirportValidator

java.lang.Object
bcu.cmp5332.bookingsystem.utils.AirportValidator
public class AirportValidator extends Object
Utility class for validating airport IATA codes. Ensures airport codes are valid 3-letter IATA codes.
Version:
3.0 - Added airport names mapping
Author:
Binay Chaudhary
